_publications._publicationTitle: Traditional and systems biology based drug discovery for the rare tumor syndrome neurofibromatosis type 2
_publications._context: Syn2 is one of two merlin-wildtype isogenic control lines in the AC-CRISPR arachnoidal cell panel (paired with Syn3-5, the merlin-deficient CRISPR/Cas9 NF2-inactivated lines from the same parental arachnoidal cell background). Developed as part of the CTF Synodos for NF2 drug discovery program.

basicInfo.description: Merlin-wildtype isogenic control arachnoidal cell line from the Synodos NF2 AC-CRISPR panel; paired control for the CRISPR/Cas9 NF2-inactivated Syn3-5 lines.
